messages:
leo: Customer legal ping: they need confirmation that for the 10-day POC all inference compute, request/response logs, and diagnostic traces will stay in the EU, and a full subprocessor CSV. Also asked whether we can guarantee no cross-border replication for telemetry. Kickoff Tue. cc @anika @priya
anika: We can run the POC in eu-only mode. For hosted set X-Redwood-Region-Preference: eu and include fail_if_unavailable=true to prevent fallbacks. That pins routing to EU pools. Note: if eu capacity is fully saturated requests will return a 503 instead of routing elsewhere when that flag is set.
priya: Exporting subprocessor list now. Current EU subprocessors: EU CSP (eu-west-1), EU CDN partner (FR/DE/IE POPs), EU observability provider (aggregated metrics only). We do not send full request/response payloads to third parties. I'll upload CSV to /legal and DM the NDA link.
sam: Pricing implication: if they insist on ad-hoc hosted eu-only routing expect ~+7-13% on per-token costs due to higher EU instance costs and less opportunistic routing. If they want predictable pricing, provision a small reserved pool for the POC (1xA10/A100 depending on model) and we can firm a short-term commit which cuts the delta.
leo: They also want to know if logs are ever replicated to the US for analytics. 
priya: For Hosted we replicate aggregated metrics for platform analytics by default; we can disable cross-border telemetry for enterprise POCs. Full request/response logs are stored in-region for Dedicated/Private and for Hosted can be restricted by contract during the POC. KMS: customer-managed keys supported for Private; hosted can use customer-managed via Bring-Your-Key for enterprise contracts.
legal-bot: Automated: POC-Checklist-1790123456.pdf uploaded to /legal/attachments/POC-1790123456. Please tag with customer name to auto-populate SOW.
infra-bot: Provisioning: eu-poc-namespace requested by leo scheduled 2026-09-14T09:00Z. Expected ready in ~12m.
anika: I'll draft a 3-line infosec answer for the questionnaire: "Compute & logs in EU during POC: Yes. Subprocessors: EU CSP, EU CDN, EU observability (CSV attached). No request/response payloads sent to third-party SaaS. Telemetry replication to US can be disabled for the POC. Failover to non-EU only occurs if fail_if_unavailable not set."
sam: DMing leo with provisional hosted vs reserved cost ranges to include in the SOW.
leo: Perfect. Priya/anika — please attach the CSV and NDA link; I'll send to customer and request signature before Tue kickoff. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
